facts.fact: The NCRST authors, writing for the International Science Council, give Namibia's National Digital Strategy as 2025-2028 (Ministry of Information and Communication Technology, 2025) and cite the text at a mict.gov.na URL, so the period brackets the February 2026 date of writing; the reference list prints the title with a typo ('202-2028') and other sources give 2025-2029.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information and Communication Technology (MICT)
systems.tiers: described as a 'comprehensive blueprint for digital transformation' to bridge the digital divide, foster innovation for economic opportunity, provide citizen-centric digital public services and promote digital literacy
prioritises AI development and digital learning
the source says Namibia 'currently lacks' one; it is being developed (February 2026)

systems.system: Task Force on the Fourth Industrial Revolution Final Report (2022)

note: No adoption verb or act is given for the National Digital Strategy, so no standing fact.
